youtube.description: 二房的車一開走，燈就暗了一分，她右手背浮出一道淺紋。福伯問「連二房也算？」，她說「散了就是散了」：該走的要走，燈暗一分、她老一分，這筆帳她認。她要福伯明晚在飯廳擺六副碗筷，有他一副：七十年了，該坐了。第42天傍晚，小滿擺好六副碗筷；知遠從祠堂進來問「桌上那枚舊銀印呢？」，祠堂的小木盒是空的，福伯臉色發白。她說東西走了會留下腳印，今天先吃這頓飯。蘇曉送了一鍋菜來，小滿拉她坐，她笑著說等知遠開口，知遠的耳朵紅了。建邦請她坐主位，福伯第一次坐上沈家的飯桌。建邦問她那天為什麼哭；她低頭笑：你喊奶奶的聲音，像你爺爺，七十八年來頭一回有人跪著叫她回家。玉琴放下筷子：「媽，爸的印，妳不是說有三枚？」她摸著戒指：「有三枚。少了一枚。」福伯低下頭。

She is the only person in the frame, not smiling; her slightly faraway eyes suddenly turn clear. She rests her chopsticks across her bowl and turns her head to look toward the head of the table. Shen Yuqin speaks a Mandarin line, her lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, suddenly very clear.

lines.speaker: yuetang-18
lines.text: 有三枚。少了一枚。

data.prompt: Inside the old Shen house dining room at night under the warm hanging lamp and candlelight. Three people: Shen Yuetang sits at the head seat, back very straight; in the right middle of the frame Shen Yuqin in her wheelchair, in profile; at the right edge Fu Bo in his grey Chinese jacket, in profile; behind them only the white west wall and candlelight; nobody smiling. The fingers of her right hand touch the old silver ring on her left ring finger; she glances at Yuqin on screen right, then toward the glow of the north window; at the right edge Fu Bo slowly lowers his head. Shen Yuetang speaks a Mandarin line, her lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, low and slow. The others keep their mouths closed.
